title: symplocos ilocana
intro: Symplocos ilocana, commonly known as the Philippine Symplocos, is a plant species in the Symplocaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of S. ilocana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
